A NOTE TO THE NEXT DECADE

May thirty feel
like permission.

Permission to want more without being ungrateful. To rest without explaining. To change your mind. To take up space. To protect your peace. To laugh loudly. To try again. To build beautiful things. To be deeply loved without having to earn it.

And on every version of that journey, I hope you remember: you do not walk it alone.

calls, gifts and noise…

That is my favourite part.
